prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Compact Cards Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a compact layout with high-visibility pet trait badges to help users choose or create a companion quickly. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate at 60.9% and a median duration of 89s, indicating friction during friend selection.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Spotlight Account Safeguard Layout: Redesign sign_in with a spotlight layout emphasizing cloud pet progress protection. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Launch Checklist Waiting Screen: Insert a new launch checklist screen before waiting to display live system setup steps while the pet compiles. (why: Home wait step has a long median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user drop-off and support issues with missing pet rendering.)
3: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Two Column Desk Setup Redesign: Redesign home_intro into a two-column view showing core pet controls and visibility shortcuts before finishing. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and finish conversion drops to 68.0%.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Quick Start Selection Hint: Add an onboarding estimated duration hint on the choose_path screen. (why: Choose path step mean time is 514s despite median of 8s, indicating stalled users.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Official Seal Incentive: Add an official registry badge component on the adoption_certificate screen. (why: Adoption is the biggest bottleneck in onboarding with only 60.9% conversion.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Desktop Notification Switch: Enable notify_when_ready alert setting on the waiting screen so users are notified when pet preparation finishes. (why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading users to switch away and forget the app.)
7: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Universal Account Persistence Hint: Add clear persistent cloud backup guidance text to sign_in. (why: Largest volume of support emails (8) involved users losing pet progress upon signing in again.)
8: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Spotlight Welcome Redesign: Redesign the story intro screen with a spotlight layout featuring companion visual assets. (why: Choose path exhibits a large mean duration of 514s at the start of onboarding.)
